source_quote.quote: STEP 2 REGISTRATION: MGMT promoter with methylation confirmed by central pathology review.
IDH mutation testing by at least one method (such as immunohistochemistry for IDH1 R132H) must be performed as part of standard of care and no mutation must be found (i.e IDH wildtype).

coder_notes: Lomustine is an established GBM therapy (D6) added to Stupp in newly diagnosed MGMT-methylated GBM, so rule 6 applies and there is no candidate (established_therapy_only). Temozolomide coded established_therapy_experiment rather than soc_backbone because its adjuvant schedule differs between arms (days 2-6 every 42 days in Arm II vs days 1-5 every 28 days in Arm I; R2 exception); it is the comparator-arm backbone in Arm I. Either way no candidate. Arm I is a registered ACTIVE_COMPARATOR. Exploratory lymphocyte/CD4 counts are not linked to a candidate. Regimen_id groups the lomustine-temozolomide (CeTeG-like) combination; lomustine regimen_id left null by oversight-free choice: see temozolomide.
